About our design tools

The image compressor reduces file size and converts between JPG, PNG and WebP locally, which is ideal for faster websites and email attachments. The color palette studio extracts colors from photos and checks text contrast against WCAG guidelines.

The QR code generator exports high-resolution codes in your own colors for print and screens.

All design tools

Frequently asked questions

Are my images uploaded to a server?

No. Images are decoded, resized and re-encoded with your browser's canvas, so they never leave your device.

Which format gives the smallest images?

WebP is usually 25–35% smaller than JPEG at similar quality and supports transparency. Use JPEG for maximum compatibility and PNG for sharp graphics or screenshots.

Do QR codes expire?

No. The QR codes you generate are static images that encode your link or text directly, so they work forever.
